packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-13 - first reader response (unverified image reading)

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, overview of face/opening 1)
- Overview shows two separate paper leaves side by side on black background, colour checker lower left, ruler at right edge.
- Pencil shelfmark notes at foot: left leaf "Stams, StA, Fragm. 228_2r"; right leaf "Stams, StA, Fragm. 228_1r" (as written on the image, read from overview).
- Not a book hand: a 17th-century-style German cursive (Kurrent) with large calligraphic flourished capitals; text is sparse, single column, wide margins. Paper with brown foxing/staining, edge losses, small holes along inner edges (sewing/punch holes?).
- Left leaf (228_2r): heading "Summa ..." with flourished S; amounts set off to right with long diagonal flourish strokes: ":700:fl"(?), ":400:fl", ":300:fl"; two short entries between (3 lines and 2 lines). Looks like an account summary page.
- Right leaf (228_1r): heading line with flourished initial (place name?), amount ":10:fl"(?), a date line, a year "1637" written large, then a title paragraph beginning with flourished "A" (7 lines). Looks like a cover/title leaf of an account ("Abraitung" = Abrechnung?). Tentative interpretation only.
- No columns, no rubrics in colour, no glosses visible.
- Tiles: image-002..010 appear to be a 3x3 tiling of this opening (002-004 top row, 005-007 middle, 008-010 bottom). Similar sets follow for overviews 011, 021, 031.

TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTIONS: German Kurrent; "fl" = the looped currency sign after amounts (looks like a long f/h-loop with flourish; read as fl(orin)? - sign retained as "fl"). u with superscript hook = ǔ. Line numbers count text lines from top of each image.

image-002 (top-left tile of left leaf 228_2r)
002/1  Sǔmma baider posten(?)          [large flourished S; "baider" fairly clear, last word "posten"? letters b-o-s-t-e-n/p-o-s-t-e-n, second letter could be "o"; tentative]
002/2              :700:fl             [preceded by long diagonal stroke; flourish after]
002/3  [top of next entry, cut at tile foot; flourished capital, see image-005]

image-003 (top-centre tile: right part of left leaf, left part of right leaf)
- Left part: overlap only ("...rposten", ":fl" flourish, "...nzwaider(?)//" at foot = same lines as image-002 and image-005).
003/1 (right leaf) [large flourished capital, probably H or G] "Hirga..." cut at tile edge - heading continues in image-004.
003/2 (right leaf, lower) [flourished capital] "Inßbr(?)..." / "Actum(?)" start of date line, cut; see image-004.

image-004 (top-right tile, right leaf 228_1r)
004/1  Hirgetinger(?) Botigweldt(?)     [flourished capital H?/G?; letters "...rgetinger" then "Bot(t)igweldt"? = "Botengeld"? - read as written: B-o-t-i-g-w-e-l-d-t, uncertain; whole line tentative]
004/2            :10:fl                  [long diagonal stroke before, flourish after; "10" fairly clear, "1" dotted like i]
004/3  Actum(?)/Inßbr(?)... de(n): 6 Februarij A(nn)o 38   [first word after flourished capital uncertain (letters ?-r-p-h-e-g-y? ending "-n"?), then "de(n):"? "6" "Februarij"? (b-r-u-a-r-i visible), "A°" with superscript o, "38"]

image-005 (middle-left tile, left leaf 228_2r)
005/1  [flourished capital, O-like loop, probably H] Herzwirdet(?) / Hirvonwirdet(?) dirzwaider(?)//   [first word letters ?-e-r-o-y-w-i-r-d-e-t? uncertain; second "dir?zwaider" uncertain; line runs on into image-006]
005/2  nimbez(?) ainßgehebt(?) und dar//    [ "u(n)d" clear; "...gehebt" fairly clear; first two words uncertain]
005/3  halb behalten//                      ["halb behalten" clear]
005/4               :400:fl                 [diagonal stroke + flourish]
005/5  Also(?) verbleibt mir(?) dirz(?) no[ch]   [capital flourished, "verbleibt" clear; "mir"/"mer" and next word uncertain; line cut at right edge -> image-006]
005/6  zuetzan(?)//                          [z with dot over u? "Zue..."; uncertain, maybe "zahlen" not secure]
005/7               :300:fl                 [cut at foot; continues image-008]

image-006 (middle-centre tile; overlap with 005 and 007)
- Left leaf line-ends (overlap): 005/1 ends "...dirzwaider//" (read here as "...rzwaider//", "w" form with a, d, e, r); 005/2 ends "und dar//" (here "und dar//" - could also be "und dur"/"darr"); 005/5 ends "dirz(?) noch" - "noch" clear here.
- Right leaf: flourished capital A/J of date line (cf. 004/3), and flourished "Abra..." of title (see 007); line starts at left edge of right leaf, one with a struck-through word (line 4 of title, horizontal stroke through initial word). No new full text.

image-007 (middle-right tile, right leaf 228_1r)
007/1  [flourished capital A/J] ?rpheßey(?) de(n): 6 Februarij(?) A(nn)o 38   [same line as 004/3; month word: initial F/f-like flourish then "ebruar..."; "A" + superscript o; "38" clear]
007/2            1637                                [large, clear; "1" in j-form]
007/3  Abraittǔng mit dem holz                      ["Abraittung" clear, ǔ with hook; "mit dem holz" fairly clear]
007/4  werckh(?) hergetingers(?) mitzayer(?)//       [first word w-e-r-c-h/werckh?; second h-e-r-g-e-t-i-n-g-e-r-s? cf. heading 004/1; third uncertain]
007/5  an(d)(?) Brennhstadt(?)/Bruggstad(?) mid(?)terg(?), Leistez(?)   [very uncertain; comma-like virgules]
007/6  [one word struck through with heavy horizontal line, illegible under stroke] zmalchner(?) und Cothiar(?)
007/7  Urnier(?), wegen deß(?) hiu(?)/hin(?)          [uncertain]
007/8  Pfenhaus(?)/Ofenhaus(?) amb(t)(?) holzgrabne(?)//   [uncertain]
007/9  [cut at foot] ...ssen(?) deß 1637: Jarß(?) ber...  [continues in image-010]

image-010 (bottom-right tile, right leaf 228_1r; top lines overlap 007/7-9)
010/1  Urnier(?), wegen deß(?) hiu(?)/hin(?)        [= 007/7]
010/2  Pfenhaus(?) ambt(?) holzpitkhabne(?)//        [= 007/8; second half "holz..." then p/s-t-k-h?-a-b-n-e uncertain]
010/3  kuessen(?)/hiessen(?) deß 1637: Jarß(?) ver//  ["1637:" clear; "Jarß"/"Jarb" uncertain; "ver//" with hyphen marks]
010/4  richten holzwerckh(?) Arbeitey(?)/Arbeiten   [read "...richten holz-werckh Arbeit..." ; last word ends in flourish]
- Rest of tile blank; pencil note "Stams, STA, Frg. 228_1r" lower right; two holes at right edge.

Not opened on face 1: image-008, image-009 (bottom-left and bottom-centre tiles). From the overview they hold only the ":300:fl" amount line and blank paper of both leaves; no further text visible in overview.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-011, overview of face/opening 2)
- Same two leaves, other sides: left leaf pencil "Stams, STA, Frg. 228_2v", right leaf "Stams, STA, Frg. 228_1v".
- Left (228_2v): entry 3 lines beginning flourished H "Hierentgegen haben sy aus(?) ..." with amount ":784:fl"(?); entry 2 lines beginning flourished A with amount "404"(?); heading "Provisoner"(?) (flourished P); list of 4 names with amounts in fl (3, 3, 2(?), 4) with flourishes.
- Right (228_1v): entry 2 lines beginning flourished "Erstens betrifft ..."(?) amount ":400:fl"; entry 3 lines "Dagegen haben ..." no amount visible(? diagonal stroke); entry 6 lines beginning flourished "Wann ..."(?) with an amount on its 4th line ("38 fl"?) and ":300:fl" below. Faint offset/show-through text lower right.

image-012 (top-left tile, left leaf 228_2v)
012/1  Hierentgegen haben sy [cut]          [flourished H; "Hierentgegen" fairly clear; "haben sy" clear]
012/2  Hoffer(?)/Kessler(?) ambt(?)/umbt(?) vermüg(?) [cut]   [first word with tall looped initial: K/H/S?; "vermüg" with dot/hook over u]
012/3  verschinten(?)/volschinten(?) empfang[en] [cut]   [first word v-e-r?-s-c-h-i-n-t-e-n; dot over i]
012/4                :784:                  [diagonal stroke before; first digit 7 (with dot above ink-blot?), then 8, 4; fl sign at edge]
012/5  [flourished capital A of next entry, cut at foot]

image-013 (top-centre tile; overlap)
- Left leaf line-ends: 012/1 "...haben sy außm" (read "außm"/"aüßm" with ß, dots over u); 012/2 "...vermüg deren(?)/derer(?)" ; 012/3 "...empfangen" (ending -gez/-gen); 012/4 ":784:fl" (7 and 8 fairly clear; 4 clear) + flourish.
- Right leaf: 013/1 [flourished capital, E?/L?] "Erstens(?) betriff[t]" ; 013/2 "kirch(?)/hirch(?) Unnbl..." cut - continues in image-014. Flourished capital of next entry at foot.

image-014 (top-right tile, right leaf 228_1v)
014/1  [Erste]ns(?) betrifft der Hertigensch(?)/Fertigensch(?)   [ "betrifft" clear (double-f ligature with crossbar); "der" clear; last word uncertain, ends with descender flourish]
014/2  [kirc]h(?) Unnbleihez(?)/Ummbleichen(?),       [uncertain; ends with virgule]
014/3                :400:fl                  [diagonal + flourish; "400" - first digit 4 fairly clear]
014/4  [foot, cut] ...hen(?) haben sy(?) ...      [start of next entry, see image-017]

image-015 (middle-left tile, left leaf 228_2v)
015/1  Also(?) bleiben(?)/dirseien(?) Ihr(?)/sy ... [cut]   [flourished capital A; "Also" fairly likely; following words uncertain; continues in image-016]
015/2  herein(?)/heruus(?)          [one word, uncertain, ends with descender]
015/3              404:fl(?)       [diagonal stroke; "4" "0"(blotted) "4" - middle digit an ink blot, could be 0; tentative "404"]
015/4      Provisoner(?)          [heading, flourished P with loop; "...ovisone..." fairly clear; last letter(s) -er/-ez cut at tile edge]
015/5  Caspar(?)/Gaspar(?) Unnbürger(?) . . .   [flourished capital C/G; second word U-n-n/n-b-ü-r-g-e-r; dotted leader]
015/6  Thoman(?)/Thomen Kichlers(?)/Pichlers(?) witib   ["witib" fairly clear; name uncertain]
